title: Fix Storybook test-runner TypeError: __test must be function not boolean
body:
Storybook test-runner expects `window.__test` to be a function but `.storybook/test-runner.cjs` was setting it as `true`, causing all 175 tests to fail with `TypeError: __test is not a function`.

## Changes

Changed `.storybook/test-runner.cjs`:
```diff
-      window.__test = true;
+      window.__test = () => {};
```

The test-runner's internal evaluation logic attempts to invoke `__test()`, requiring a callable. Changed from boolean to no-op function.
